_comment: icraft #35 Cataclysm boss-only Tetra material (refight-to-repair). REPAIR ITEM = cataclysm:witherite_ingot. Witherite drops ONLY as cataclysm:witherite_block from The Harbinger (ancient_factory, deep underground, T3-T4); the block unpacks 1->9 into witherite_ingot via Cataclysm's vanilla crafting recipe. Witherite is a wither/decay themed metal: high primary, deliberately LOW durability (1000) so the item wears down -- and since witherite has no other source, the ONLY way to repair a witherite-built Tetra item is to refight The Harbinger. Mirrors the ancient_metal schema (icraft #57). Tools + armor.
